doc.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Carnegie Hall, bebop and the big bands
title: Ellington's later invitation in Europe
summary: Ellington often visited Indianapolis and asked Hampton to join him after a Prague concert in the 1970s.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Duke, I’d also – I’d heard Duke many times. They came to Indianapolis many times. Sometimes the band was very good, and sometimes it wasn’t. Finally he asked me to join the band, but I wasn’t available at the time.
That came when I was living in Europe.
I was living in Europe in the ’60s too.

’68, I started living in Europe. But I think it was in the ’70s that I played a concert in Prague, Czechoslovakia. Duke played the concert also. I was conducting the band. It was my music. He asked me to go with him.
